resources.string: Window processing · Shared
Process multiple apps

Off (default): process only the active window. On: detect each selected app that is visible, automatically following one, two or three apps. Turn this on when using one Shorts app beside another app too. Hidden apps are not processed. This does not force either app to play if it pauses. Switching modes preserves each app’s settings and does not turn on execution.
